question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard UK delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery (1-2 days) is available at checkout.
embedding_text: UK standard delivery 3-5 business days express 1-2 days

question: Do you offer free shipping?
answer: Yes, free standard shipping on orders over £50 within the UK.
embedding_text: Free shipping orders over 50 pounds UK

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return unworn items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must have original tags attached.
embedding_text: 30 day return policy unworn items tags attached full refund

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Log into your account, go to Order History, select the order, and click 'Request Return'. You'll receive a prepaid label by email.
embedding_text: Start return from order history prepaid label email

question: How do I find my size?
answer: Each product page has a Size Guide link. We use standard UK sizing for women and men.
embedding_text: Size guide on product page UK sizing women men

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay.
embedding_text: Payment methods visa mastercard amex paypal apple pay

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up on the homepage, enter your email and password, and verify your email address.
embedding_text: Create account sign up email password verify

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once shipped, you'll receive a tracking email with a link. You can also track from your account Order History.
embedding_text: Track order tracking email order history account

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement if not yet dispatched. Contact support or use your account dashboard.
embedding_text: Cancel order within one hour not dispatched

question: How do I use a discount code?
answer: Enter your code in the 'Promo Code' field at checkout before payment. One code per order.
embedding_text: Discount promo code checkout one per order

question: How should I wash my clothes?
answer: Check the care label on each garment. Most cotton items: machine wash 30°C, do not tumble dry unless stated.
embedding_text: Care label machine wash 30 degrees cotton

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: We currently ship to the UK and selected EU countries. Delivery times vary by destination.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: Gift wrapping is available at checkout for £3.95. You can add a personal message on the packing slip.

question: An item is out of stock — will it come back?
answer: Popular items are restocked regularly. Sign up for back-in-stock alerts on the product page.
embedding_text: Out of stock restock alerts product page

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@stylehub.demo or use the chat assistant. We respond within 24 hours on business days.
embedding_text: Contact customer support email chat 24 hours
